scope: Two constant-phi solver layouts compare with the same current production compiler on baseab59. Both subjects use the same61 program flags plus scheduling2; compiler PGO is disabled and its earlier frozen-source result remains separate.

The first layout is rejected: cleanup and instructions rise in both blocks despite slightly favorable whole-compiler means and mixed compiler blocks. Every raw observation and adverse stage/memory/block result remains. Two early direct-harness setup/link failures execute no tests and remain; production source is unchanged in their correction.

Exact source snapshots/patches, commands, logs, raw timings, generated programs/executables and fixed native inputs are included. Compiler/test executables and compiler intermediates are excluded/SHA-pinned. Unchanged sources/toolchain/dependency cache are pinned rather than redistributed. Pure replay validates saved observations without rerunning builds or timings. The complete-compilation goal below ten seconds remains open.
